MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 30

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

4. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x > 5
   D. x = 5

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 33
   C. 14
   D. 22

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 44

9. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 16

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

11. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 8
   C. 49
   D. 7

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

15. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 30
   C. 18
   D. 36

17. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

18. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

22. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

23. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 10

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
